item.description: As revolutionary agitation, Islamist extremism and anti-Jewish incitement converge, America must confront a dangerous erosion of Jewish security before hatred becomes an accepted feature of public life. We must hoose candidates who will fight antisemitism. Opinion.

item.title: Shabbat Shalom!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 17:28 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom!
